name: Alto DUSD
oneLiner: DUSD is Alto's overcollateralized USD stablecoin minted from isolated on-chain markets backed by ETH, BTC, and yield-bearing variants, with a 5M USDC PSM.
collateral: Over-collateralized on-chain assets in isolated lending markets on Ethereum: mint markets accept WETH, wstETH (Lido), rETH (Rocket Pool), mETH (Mantle LST), sUSDe (Ethena), and Syrup USDC; borrow markets accept cbBTC, WBTC, tBTC, sUSDe, Syrup USDC, and PAXG; each market is independently isolated with per-asset risk parameters; a Peg Stability Module enables 1:1 USDC↔DUSD swaps capped at 5M USDC
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized minting via isolated lending markets (mint and borrow); peg backstopped by a PSM enabling 1:1 USDC↔DUSD swaps at 0.20% fee (5M USDC cap); arbitrageurs exploit the PSM rate vs. market price to restore peg; all markets governed by ALTO token holder votes

oracleRisk.summary: Twelve registry-authorized debt-bearing Ethereum markets use market-local Chainlink compositions, with ERC-4626 or native exchange-rate legs where required. Each oracle reverts on stale, non-positive, incomplete, or reverting input and has no cache or automatic fallback; the affected market therefore fails closed. Wrapper-rate modules cap upward growth from stored checkpoints while accepting decreases. Every market, oracle, and liquidation engine is owned by AltoTimelockController with a contract-enforced 3,600-second minimum delay; administrative replacement is not automatic failover. The separate fixed-price USM/PSM routes do not create borrower debt positions and are excluded from liquidation branches.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 ORCL curation
branchApplicability.rationale: At Ethereum block 25531915, the on-chain Market Registry returned seven mint markets and five borrow markets, all with nonzero debt. All twelve are retained as isolated oracle/liquidation branches, including mETH and tBTC mint markets omitted by Alto's public snapshot: both were frozen for new activity but debt-bearing and liquidation-active. The separate USDC and frxUSD USM/PSM deployments exchange at administrator-configured fixed-price strategies and create no borrower-owned collateral position, collateral-ratio test, or liquidation path, so they are reviewed as not applicable to the branch inventory.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648324. The verified DUSD source contains no blacklist, freeze, or per-account transfer restriction, and plain ERC-20 transfers are not gated by the PAUSE_TYPE flag, which bounds only mint() and burn(). Two contract pausers (0xe318d8f0dc3c10f507ab7a199e4511fb09737bdf, 0x1c11d2d42929bd17ab7212b79c91862adfa8bbe4) were granted PAUSE_TYPE at deployment block 23908270 and remain active; zero Paused events have ever been emitted, so the pause path is unused and does not reach ordinary transfers. The live holder-intervention surface is seizure-by-burn: burn(from, amount) lets any owner-authorized burner debit an arbitrary account, bounded by that burner's own minterConfig.minted counter. Full SetBurnerStatus history (15 events) leaves the 11 active market/USM contracts as current burners, and the owner can authorize further burners through setBurnerStatus. owner() at block 25648324 remains AltoTimelockController (0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86, getMinDelay 3600 seconds) whose proposer/executor is the 3-of-5 Alto Safe 0xc49bf619cc9a68f84a6c9ab88506f2627565a4d0, so every access change passes a one-hour governance delay; failure-domain identity is the token owner timelock plus the governance Safe, with burn reach mediated by the 11 authorized market/USM contracts. Zero PeerSet events confirm no LayerZero OFT peers, so the token is single-chain with no bridged representations. reviewedStatus is true (individual reach): owner-mediated contracts can burn DUSD from individual holders even though no transfer blacklist or freeze function exists. Inherited upstream exposure is tracked on the linked assets: 90.4% of backing is frxUSD held by the frxUSD USM, with sUSDe and syrupUSDC collateral slices.

controls.label: AltoTimelockController (DUSD owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540452, DUSD.owner() = 0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86. Verified DUSD source restricts setMinterStatus and setMinterCeiling to onlyOwner, so this timelock can add/revoke a minter and raise or lower any token-level ceiling. Its getMinDelay() is 3600 seconds; existing RoleGranted/RoleRevoked evidence resolves the proposer/executor Safe and revocation of deployer roles.

controls.label: Alto governance Safe (proposer/executor on timelock)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540452, getOwners() returned the five listed owners, getThreshold() returned 3, and getModulesPaginated() returned no enabled modules. hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, Safe) and hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, Safe) both returned true on the DUSD owner timelock. It can therefore schedule and execute the owner's setMinterStatus and setMinterCeiling calls after the current 1-hour timelock delay.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540452, DUSD.owner() = AltoTimelockController (0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86). Verified DUSD source shows mint() is limited to allowedMinter[msg.sender] and minterConfig[msg.sender].ceiling, while onlyOwner can change minter status and ceilings. The direct, non-proxy constructor only initializes the pauser and does not seed a minter or ceiling. Full SetMinterStatus and SetMinterCeiling history from block 0 returned 15 and 29 events respectively; state reads over the 13 unique status-event addresses found 11 active minters and 2 inactive addresses. The controls enumerate the complete active set at this block. The owner timelock remains governed by the 3-of-5 Alto Safe after its 1-hour delay.

sources.label: Alto DUSD mint and borrow documentation

reserveReview.rationale: Alto documents that only mint markets create DUSD; borrow markets redistribute lender-supplied DUSD and are not backing sources. The 2026-07-21 issuer API reports active mint-market DUSD debt of 32,735.51647 against sUSDe, 3,903.60575 against WETH, 885.53777 against syrupUSDC, 633.58275 against rETH, and 49,500.86509 against wstETH. Combining those debts with the USM's 822,997.840132 frxUSD balance at Ethereum block 25580115 still rounds to 90.4% frxUSD, 5.9% ETH/LST collateral, 3.6% sUSDe, and 0.1% syrupUSDC.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current issuer API mint-market DUSD debt combined with the on-chain USM underlying balance
